notes.title: Happy Synthversary Update!
notes.content:
Today, back in 2018, we launched a VR game that blended dance choreography with rhythm gaming and a whole lot of synthwave vibes. Synth Riders has grown so much since then – and to celebrate in style, we have a HUGE Synthversary update that includes a brand new FREE song for everyone: ‘Behemoth’ by Faux Tales! 

The best part? It's available right now as a gift to all you awesome riders out there whether you’re playing on PC, Meta Quest 3, or on PSVR2.
PLAY Faux Tales’ Behemoth Track NOW[previewyoutube="2PTwTMWcJfA;full"][/previewyoutube]
You’re probably already familiar with Faux Tales’ work….but didn’t realize it. The experimental cinematic sonic style of Timo Loosli (the man behind the sound) has been in everything from game trailers and films, to TV shows, commercials, expos, and frankly, too many things to list here.

If you didn’t already click on the video embed above, the swelling sounds in ‘Behemoth’ are about to take you on a journey. Just close your eyes and listen – you’ll notice rock catching waves of atmospheric electronica.

It goes without saying, we’re HUGE fans of Faux Tales and we couldn’t think of a better way to celebrate our anniversary. You can find the game, right now, in the “Specials” section.

A huge thanks to our beatmapping and choreography team for transforming his track into something that moves us. Thanks to Timo Loosli for being awesome enough to share this music with us. And, of course, thank you – yes, YOU there person reading this. 

CONTENT CREATOR UPDATE: Twitch Integration!
We’re happy to report that with this Synthversary update, you’ll also see the return of the native Twitch Integration! It’s something we’ve been working on so that Streamers can once again take song requests – or, more accurately – be trolled by chat. 

Besides that, you’re going to find visual improvements around neon and post-processing effects to support our creators, including mixed reality creators using LIV who can now capture with bloom! We appreciate everyone in the community who reached out to us about these features – we’ve been listening and continue to grow based on what you share with us.

When we talked with Abraham Aguero, co-creator of Synth Riders, about this a little while back, he said, “I can’t believe how many people like to play, connect and share the game and the experience of playing it with others, the Synth Riders Community always surprises me with something new every day.” 

We hope to continue surprising our community – and look forward to how you surprise us as well.
MUSIC PACK UPDATE: Cyberpunk Essentials = Monstercat Music Pack
In addition, a quick heads up for all you Cyberpunk / Monstercat fans out there: If you previously picked up the Cyberpunk Essentials Music Pack, it’s undergoing a name change to the “Monstercat Music Pack.” 

What’s with the name change?  All your favorite free and purchased Monstercat tracks are now waiting in their new home, the Monstercat Music Pack. Simple as that. 
Two songs that were originally in Cyberpunk Essentials vol. 1 – “Takeover" by Zardonic and "Cyberpunk (Synth Riders Version)" by Extra Terra – can now be found in their new home as part of the free content in Synthwave Essentials Volume 2.
EVEN MORE COMING IN 2025
Beyond the seven-year celebration mentioned above, we really do have some exciting things ahead. We still have more Music Packs to drop….and some other fun things in the works before the end of 2025. 

It’s a little too early to say more except for maybe, THANKS!

We wouldn’t be here, seven years later, without your continued support!

notes.title: Synth Riders [Loves]❤️ You With Free Tracks to Try!
notes.content:
New FREE Song and Try-Before-You-Buy Experience™

Why is it that people and brands (AHEM) wait until Valentine’s Day to officially share the love? 

This year at Synth Riders we’re delivering a new, free track that players voted on (‘Got You’ by Sunset Neon. It’s sick. You’ll love it.). We are also rotating in a new Synth Riders Experience that you can try once before you buy: Lindsey Stirling’s ‘Underground.’ Really, though, this is just the start of what we’re doing here, all year round. Why?

Because…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33094909/19e46de0d31763b2b712724a38f9bc2d24269f8b.png
"Hey Riders, Falcon here from Kluge - one of my favorite things about working on Synth Riders is bringing new experiences to our players. Whether it’s a new addition to their library or creating opportunities for players to have a sneak peek into paid content, it’s always exciting to give our community more ways to connect with the music. I can’t wait for everyone to jump in and enjoy what we’ve put together!"

NEW Free Song: ‘Got You’ By Sunset Neon

We recently asked all you Riders out there which song YOU would like added to the game this February. The winner: Sunset Neon. (It was close, though! Prizm and Swingrowers also have songs that slap!)

[previewyoutube=z1xnWvvwfWE;full][/previewyoutube]
This track, in particular, marries pop vocals and melodies with a synthy vibe and totally awesome bassline. It’ll for sure get you moving on the floor. As a thanks to all of you, it’s also now a permanent track added into the collection (It’s listed under the “Specials” music pack). Play it now and let us know how much you love it!

To celebrate our newest free song in Synth Riders we're also throwing down the "Got You Dizzy" Challenge in-game. Do you like Spirals? We'll see how you feel after this one. (and don’t forget to look for more heart-racing, love-themed challenges this month.)


NEW – Try Lindsey Stirling’s Synth Riders Experience™ for FREE!

When Lindsey Stirling’s ‘Underground’ dropped as a Synth Riders Experience, people went bonkers! It captured the frantic energy that Lindsey brings to her performances and transported you to the cyber-violin dimension. (If that’s not a thing, we’re making that official, here.) Last year we let players try it for free. Starting now, we’ve rotated in ‘Underground,’ as the new Experience track you can try before you buy!

[previewyoutube=sieojqlbLAw;full][/previewyoutube]
While you can see a bit of what it’s like on a flat screen here, you really need the firsthand feel to truly appreciate what an Experience is all about. 

Starting with the latest update, all players on Meta Quest 2/3 , PSVR2, and Steam get to play the ‘Underground’ once. In fact, it’s unlocked right now, so fire it up!

Showing Our ❤️ to the Community, Year-Round

We aren’t stopping there. We’re looking to have more giveaways, freebies, deals, and feature updates that we think you’re going to love all year long.

Can’t say more about it right now, but keep an eye on our social channels and our Discord where we are ALWAYS dropping hints and hooking you up with a fun time. Let’s just put it this way: We have big things planned for Synth Riders and we are incredibly excited for what’s coming as we get deeper into 2025 and beyond! 

Most important, though, we need to say how much we appreciate all of you. Since we officially launched Synth Riders in 2018, we’ve created a game and a community that we’re incredibly proud of here. None of this would be possible without YOU, the person reading this post. That’s why we’re still here, that’s why we’re doing this in the first place. 

Thank you – and thanks for riding the rails with us.

notes.title: Long Awaited 3.x Update is Live & It Comes With a Whole New UI!
notes.content:
SYNTH RIDERS’ 3.x Update Is Live With The Addition of New UI Update! 

Big changes are coming to Synth Riders, starting today — a beautiful, streamlined interface that makes it easier to find Challenges, Experiences, and the songs you want to play. In fact, there are some fantastic features that you might have missed before now.

Before anything else, though, update your copy of Synth Riders to check out the new UI and enjoy uninterrupted game play. This version of the game will not be compatible for online play with players on the previous versions.

Custom content has been moved! If you jump into your Synth Riders Install folder, you will find a folder named Synth Riders UC, this is where all custom content now live and it will require you to move your files into the appropriate sections within it to work again.

With that all out of the way, let’s take a quick look at what’s here and, if you’re paying close attention, you might even pick up hints about what’s next for the music rhythm game world we’ve been building.

We’re always looking for ways to make the game work even more smoothly and we knew that the time was right to cook up a look that screams, “We love 80s Synthwave style!” even louder. 

Here’s the page that now greets you when the game starts….and notice that new “Challenges” button in the corner? Hit it! The challenges no longer nestled inside menus! We’ll get to that in a second.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33094909/7cbc5f9e7371f24e97d1706419782ca5c9d0b0ab.png
 
You have quick, simple access to all the main components of the game and there’s a little message window for when we have fun updates and new content. As you can see, we want to get you where you want to be, ASAP, giving you easy push-button access to everything Synth Riders offers. (It’s a lot!)

In this screenshot example, this is what you’ll see after picking “Solo” mode. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33094909/97ec7019aab75a99bf1965c460d837882b54d6eb.png

It’s easier than ever to choose modifiers (like Spin and Spiral modes), tracks, and quickly spot where you stand on the leaderboards—if you’re all about score-chasing.  We were originally thinking of dropping circles and arrows on different bits of these images here to illustrate changes, but the whole point of the UI change was to keep it streamlined. We like to think between the main menu and layout here, we’re on the right track. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33094909/ad3785e842f2ded9b7fb60f667b18f0c97d1dc3c.png

As we said up top, we made the Challenges easier to locate and navigate! It’s another great feature inside of Synth Riders that we don’t want anyone to miss. Right at the top of the welcome screen you can jump right to see the latest community challenges. Speaking of which, have you jumped into the Synth Riders Discord? Come join the fun—maybe make a few suggestions for challenges and new songs you’d like to play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33094909/ba907868a5500ee36424785c5c707e0a6bfaa83e.png

ICYMI: EXPERIENCES CONTINUE – AND YOU CAN TRY ONE FOR FREE!

We knew we needed to make it easier for you to explore our Synth Riders Experiences™ as well, with a dedicated section accessible from the main menu. They blow away everyone who tries them. Honestly, though, it is tough to explain it to someone. Seeing is believing, after all.

At the beginning of September, we opened Muse's “Algorithm” Experience™ so that you can try it one time for free. It’s right there, now, in the app, waiting for everyone whether you bought it or not. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33094909/1c9b3e098c246bd8ee815c2fb9408d86752a2c51.png

Fire it up, play the track, and if it moves you, the DLC is available for purchase. While on the subject of Experiences™, this is just the start! We already have a few you can play right now, but we have even more unique ones on the horizon. Big things are coming to Synth Riders and we are incredibly excited for later this year, into 2025, and beyond.

notes.title: Synth Riders Goes Totally 80s with Latest Music Pack!
notes.content:
Synth Riders Goes Totally 80s with Latest Music Pack

Today, Synth Riders drops some totally awesome DLC: A trip back to the 1980s! What’s in store with The 80s Mixtape – Side A (besides flashbacks to hanging out at the mall)?  
 
First, there’s an 80s-inspired stage available at no additional cost. We also created most excellent beatmaps for five songs from the era. Best of all, it’s available right now, whether you play Synth Riders on Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3 or Steam enabled VR headset.

[previewyoutube=aZ9JHUpt6LE;full][/previewyoutube]

a-ha - Take on Me
You know it by heart, the pencil-drawn video that’s broken many a karaoke singer trying to match Morten Harket’s high notes when he belts out, “In a day or twoooooo….!” Well, we are taking that song to new (interactive) levels in Synth Riders 80s Mixtape - Side A!

Starship - We Built This City
Starship’s protest song against closing Los Angeles music venues is peak pop rock. Mickey Thomas and Grace Slick’s vocals roasting corporate expansion became an 80s anthem — in a decade of corporate expansion.
  
Devo - Whip It
When a problem comes along, you know what to do: Strap on your Devo-approved energy dome. (For real, that’s a thing.) This song – and its video – cemented Devo as an early pioneer of US New Wave. Now, we say, “Whip It” in Synth Riders! 

Phil Collins - Sussudio
What did you say when you had your first schoolyard crush? Was it something like “Sussudio?” That’s what Phil Collins’ mid-80s song is all about. Just take a nonsense word, a horn section and the heavy funk influence of “1999” by Prince and you’re all set!

INXS - New Sensation
Australia's INXS, with its huge drums, relentless guitars, and sax solos define late 1980s rock. Combine that with the distinctive vocal growls of Michael Hutchence on “New Sensation” and you’ve got a Synth Riders track that grabs you and won’t let go.

 
...and, as we mentioned at the top, we have the 80s-inspired stage, “Endless Cafe.”

notes.title: Lindsey Stirling Music Pack & Experience is now available!

Synth Riders invites players to come and explore a world “Underground” with the Lindsey Stirling Music Pack.  This pack captures Lindsey’s expressive and energetic playing style as you ride the rails and soar with her violin in five tracks spanning her career.

A multi-talented musician, songwriter and dancer, Lindsey Stirling blends her trademark violin with a multitude of musical styles.  This pack highlights her diversity and versatility: whether playing alongside the powerhouse vocals of Lzzy Hale in “Shatter Me”, exploring her Celtic musical influences in “First Light”, in collaboration with Raja Kumari on the Bollywood-inspired “Mirage” and even in the Synthwave-inspired “Shadows”, Lindsey’s violin is your guide.

As an artist with a strong sense of visual style, the Synth Riders Experience for “Underground” is heavily inspired by the striking imagery of Lindsey’s own video for the song, while continuing to explore themes of confinement and freedom, key inspiration for the song itself.  This Synth Riders Experience is very much a playable video clip, with its hand crafted visuals matched perfectly to the music creating a truly unique, immersive way to experience music.

In a first for Kluge Interactive, the Synth Riders team collaborated with Lindsey Stirling on location to create this amazing trailer, featuring an electrifying performance from her.

Settings & System

 Doesn't apply to the streamer and moderators if the queue permissions are set. Blacklisted songs go into the queue history when requested. When you blacklist a song thats in the queue it will be removed too

Queue List

 !srset queuelist and cooldowns available as usual with the moderator queue permission.

notes.content:
Hey Riders!

From the bright neon of The Rooftop in Spin City, Synth Riders goes out of this world, touching down on the surface of The Planet!  Spaceships soar and walkers stride around the base during the totality of an Eclipse.  Gorgeous new visuals, an enhanced multiplayer room for more interaction possibilities to coincide with the introduction of Custom Experiences, a reimagining of “Spin City” and a brand new spin stage called “Eclipse” await you in this update - along with much, much more!

SPIN STAGE & HOME STAGE UPDATES

Enjoy a brand new Spin Stage, “Eclipse” which takes you to another planet far, far away - where robots roam and spaceships rule the skies.	
Our existing “Spin City” stage has been completely redesigned, adding a new level of richness and depth never before seen in Synth Riders.
Both these stages are also available for selection in standard play mode, or as your Home Stage (Settings > Visuals > Home Stage) as "The Rooftop" & "The Planet".


AN IMPROVED MULTIPLAYER EXPERIENCE

Players can now teleport around in the Multiplayer room, which is now a shared space!  Just point to an empty hex where you wish to go and pull the trigger to jump!

If you find crowds a little overwhelming, you can always find a clear space in “The Room”.  Go to Settings > Visuals > Home Stage and select “The Room” and “Load Stage” to enjoy the voice chat only experience from the comfort of your futuristic apartment!
Room hosts can now mute a player for the whole room at once using Global Mute. Sort, Filter & Random Song Improvements

 Sort & Filter saved between songs.
 Selecting "Random Song" from the song summary screen will not repeat songs you've played in the current session.
 "Random Song" will try to stick to the song difficulty of the first song when available. If the difficulty is not available in the next random song, it picks the nearest available.

Multiplayer

 Banned players can no longer rejoin a room by manually entering the room name.
 Individual player settings panel size increased to make it easier to access controls for adjusting mute, relative audio level (all players) and ban (room host only) for other players in the room.


No Fail -50% Penalty Only Applies When You Fail

 There’s no reason not to use No Fail with friends in Multiplayer Mode now!  When you enable the "No Fail" modifier, the score modifier and leaderboard tag will only apply when your energy bar reaches zero.  At that point while playing, instead of failing out of the song, you can continue playing but your score for the song will be halved and your score will be tagged as "No Fail" on the leaderboard.


Camera Improvements (PCVR Only)

 Selecting Settings > Visuals > Display Camera > Off now correctly disables the camera on the menu scenes. This is recommended for performance if you are not capturing the window.
 Settings > Visuals > Display Camera > Window Size settings are now sticky.
 Scriptable, simulated camera movement through making the playspace rotate while you play is now available.  This is an awesome effect which content creators can use to make their mixed reality videos even more amazing!  For more information on this, please see https://bit.ly/srcamera	
 LIV SDK Updated to 1.5.4.
 Controller trails updated.

 You'll now be prompted for a water break at the song end screen, rather than waiting until you return to the main menu (thanks HeavyGee).
 Finished Challenges display correctly when in Multiplayer.
 Room Adjustment now applies correctly while playing on Quest.
 Various typo fixes.


Twitch Integration

 When Power-Ups are disabled, score uploads are no longer disabled for !color, !invaderz, or !warp as these do not help the player. In addition, they are only disabled for !vanish and !prismatic when used in conjunction with the corresponding gameplay modifiers.

notes.title: "Power-Ups" for Multiplayer Free Update is Live!
notes.content:
Dear Riders, we are proud to present a free "Power-Ups" update for Multiplayer and reveal a new Music Pack featuring Muse that will launch in January!

Multiplayer Levels Up With Power-Ups
Our power-ups update brings the fun of Kart racer-style boosts and attacks to Multiplayer Mode!  “Power-Ups” are a set of special effects classed into “Attacks” and “Boosts”.  Players collect Power-Ups by hitting energized notes scattered through the song, then may launch them when they want to attack other players or boost themselves.

To celebrate the release, we invited some community-favorite VR content creators to experience “Power-Ups” together, and we all want to share the fun in the trailer below:

https://youtu.be/b-dETx1kd7U

Playing With Power-Ups
In Multiplayer you’ll find a new panel which replaces the Multiplayer Settings panel, but there’s a quick access button to the Multiplayer Settings available at the bottom of the new panel! For the player holding the crown, this panel controls the Power-Ups and allows you to Enable or Disable them entirely, or select individual Boosts and Attacks that will be in play.  The other players in the room will see your selections as you make them displayed on their panels..

New Config Settings for Power-Ups
There are two new settings which affect Power-Ups:

Settings > Multiplayer > Power-Ups
Here you can choose left, right trigger (also for Push To Talk), grips or other combinations for launching your Power-Ups here.

Settings > Audio > Special Effects > Power-Ups
This volume control determines how loud the sound effects will be for Power-Ups.
How Do You Play With Power-Ups?
Start your Multiplayer game as usual with Power-Ups Enabled, you will see special “energized notes” - these can be hit with either hand, or skipped without breaking your combo.  When you hit the energized note, you will get a Power-Up indicated below the clock in the HUD.  To launch the Power-Up, pull the trigger you set in Settings > Multiplayer > Power-Ups.


 When playing with Power-Ups, the only way to accrue a score multiplier for hitting notes consecutively is via the Power-Up!
 Targeting is automatic, and based on your position on the leaderboard and could be players ahead, behind - or to everyone!
 When someone sends you a Power-Up attack, you will see their name, so be sure to thank them on the in-game voice chat - it’s only polite.
 Also look out for the Boosts and in particular the Shield - this usually absorbs attacks, but if you deploy at the right time your revenge will be swift as you bounce back the attack.


What Do The Other Power-Ups Do?
We don’t want to spoil the fun for you by describing what each Power-Up does, but there are a bunch for you to try!  You can also continue to use regular modifiers with Power-Ups enabled to produce interesting effects (not always what you expect!) and this includes Spin Mode!

"Synthwave Essentials 2" feat. Muse
We are proud to reveal that the next stop on our roadmap will be a third DLC music pack, “Synthwave Essentials 2”, coming on January 14th and featuring songs from Muse, the superstars of alternative rock!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33094909/54ba1847bfa0ab676a83d9cdb27a6169a7636d05.png

Twitch Integration
We’ve tied the Power-Ups with Twitch Integration too, so there’s a lot of new features here for our Twitch content creators!

- On startup, the bot posts a link to the Twitch Integration Guide, which is our central “How To” document for setting up and controlling all aspects of Twitch Integration for streamers. May be disabled by the streamer or a moderator if moderatortoggle is enabled by using !set twitchhelp false

- Request queue attribution - hover your pointer over a song in the queue to see a Tooltip showing which player requested it,
- !oops - new command which removes the latest request by a viewer from the queue. This can be done multiple times. May be disabled by the streamer or a moderator if moderatorqueue is enabled with !set oops false

- !commandlist - new command which lists all available commands for activated options (excluding moderator and streamer commands and excluding the command itself).  May be disabled by the streamer or a moderator if moderatortoggle is enabled with !set commandlist false

- New Power-Ups available as commands for Twitch Integration - you can now use !vanish, !embiggen, !minimize and !warp.  Score uploads are disabled for !embiggen and !timewarp.

- Subsequent speed change commands now override the previous speed command.
- With the exception of speed commands, Twitch Integration now works in Multiplayer!
- Twitch Integration works in Spin Mode, including Invaderz!
- Removed LIV Gamechanger integration
- Cosmetic changes to match Twitch Integration to Power-Ups.

Bug Fixes / Improvements
Settings > Multiplayer > Push To Talk - now supports left or right only to allow configuration alongside Power-Ups
Vanish notes tooltip in Multiplayer fixed (thanks @Xrayxout )

Our algorithm spots walls which do not impact on the game play area and are used mainly to add to the atmosphere (such as the overhead wall tunnels in “Phoenix”), and then these can be turned off to improve performance.

100% Perfect Hits?  That’s Incredible!
Now that we’ve seen players getting a perfect hit on every note in a song, we’ve added a special “Incredible” message seen on song completion, and those have their scores marked on the leaderboard with gold lightning bolts. notes.title: Update 2.3.1.a26
notes.content:
Score Rebalancing
After lots of discussion with players, we’re adjusting the values of notes, rails and specials to give a better overall score experience.

The new values for notes hit as Perfect are:

 Standard Notes - 1000 points
 One-Handed Special (Green) - 1500 points
 Two-Handed Special (Gold) - 2000 points


Rails are then calculated at double those values per second of time on the rail:

 Standard Rail - 2000 points per second
 One-Handed Special Rail (Green) - 3000 points per second
 Two-Handed Special Rail (Gold) - 4000 points per second


Hit Detection Changes
We’ve made some changes to our hit detection system, and now the shape of the hit detection surfaces better matches what you see in game (yes, they’re spherical!)  This should be more intuitive for players, is properly unidirectional - but will mean you’ll need to make a bit more effort to get to the centres of the notes!

Small / Large Notes
Previously these modifiers have been cosmetic only, but not anymore!  To spice things up, we’re really making small notes harder to hit (you’ll really have to earn that modifier bonus!).  At the same time, we’re making large notes easier for you to hit if you’re someone who needs a bit of help to pass those more difficult maps.

Extra Options for Graphics
In the Visuals menu, there are new options to control graphics. You can now choose a level for the neon glow effect, and there is a new Advanced button which gives you a menu of new graphics adjustments to help you tune game performance.  You can adjust the quality of textures, lower antialiasing and anisotropic levels and toggle alpha blending on particles.

Confirmation Prompt for Game Exit button
When you exit the game using the exit button located on the main stage platform, you will be asked to confirm that you wish to exit the game.  This will prevent accidentally exiting the game, particularly during Multiplayer games while using Push to Talk!

Configurable Game Pause Delay
You can now specify how long you wish the pause button to be held down before the game will pause during a song.  This is helpful for players who hold controllers in such a way that accidentally pausing the game is a problem.

Fade Music (Ducking) for Multiplayer Voice Chat
In Multiplayer, a new option allows you to have the game automatically duck the music when other players speak.  You can configure this to happen either just in the Lobby, where it will fade out the preview music and menu background, or always.

Bug Fixes / Improvements

 In Multiplayer, the announcer will now wait a while before telling you your position.
 Song Request queue is working again for Twitch Integration.
 More work behind the scenes on LIV SDK 1.5, fix for Mixed Reality players will be coming soon first in LIV public_beta, so if you want to be ready you can swap to that in advance if you wish!

You ask - we deliver! We’ve just added three new T-shirts to our store on RedBubble. You can now proudly wear the official logo of the game, or go. New t-shirts (with a link: https://www.redbubble.com/people/synthriders/shop)

We want to thank everyone who has let us know about all these things for helping make Synth Riders a better game for everyone!  There are a lot of changes in this patch, we've detailed as much of it as we can here.

FORCE MODE

 After feedback from our Force playing community, the Force setting has been changed to the equivalent setting of the old “normal” modifier.  This should make Force mode more enjoyable for everyone (thanks ELZ, NotKouto, emikodo)


MULTIPLAYER

 Multiplayer scores for rooms with more than 5 players now display correctly (thanks Xrayxout).
 Multiplayer - players marked as "Not Ready" are still being brought into the game (thanks Glonkable)
 Multiplayer - wins not being updated in the main board (thanks Camelellogram)
 Setting Voice Chat to Always and leaving Push to Talk off now correctly lets you talk while playing (thanks Gruntled)


TWITCH INTEGRATION

 Prismatic notes behave correctly with the !rainbow command (thanks GeeseBreath)
 Colour randomization with !color colours the rails correctly (thanks Wirrel)
 Back arrow on the Queue menu works correctly (thanks Wirrel)


STAGES

 “Spin City” is now selectable as a stage for use outside of Spin Mode!
 Objects in the Spin City stage no longer disappear on head movement (thanks T-railed, Ichderhorst)


SETTINGS

 Multiple selections of the Load Scene button in Settings no longer causes a problem loading the ready room world (thanks Xrayxout)
 Auto Height & Units options in the Settings > Calibration Menu now work correctly (thanks mvoosten)
 Time format updated for Quest users on the platform clock behind the player (thanks Gruntled)


OFFLINE PLAY

 You are again able to play offline (thanks ThatDylan).  In this mode, scores will not be saved or submitted.


SCORES & LEADERBOARDS

 You may now swap between two leaderboard views.
 Combined view shows all scores regardless of modifiers used.
 Modified view shows only those scores set using the modifiers which you have selected 
 Player’s own score will now show again on the Friends tab in leaderboards (thanks Xoanon)

notes.title: HUGE Update - "Spin Mode" is here!
notes.content:
Hey Riders!  

We are so excited to deliver to you a really huge update to Synth Riders, packed full of features and changes which we hope all of you are as excited about as we are!

A Whole New Spin for Every Map!
Just select the Spin Mode for the angle you’d like to play - from 90, 180, 360, or the amazing 360+ which elevates your play to new heights.  Then you can increase the intensity of your spin experience from Mild to Styled.. or Wild!  We’ve created a unique spin algorithm (nothing random!), which preserves the original linear mapped experience while adding an extra dimension of spin to the map.  This means that all players have the same spin experience and can compete to be the top of the spin leaderboard for each difficulty!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ainP_T1iyvE
Welcome to Spin City - Where the Neon’s Back and Bright!
To compliment our new Spin Mode, we have created a special stage called “Spin City” - and the Rooftop is now your new landing place when you launch the game.  In graphics updates with this release, we have brought back the neon glow and flash effects (you can turn these off in Settings > Visuals if you wish), plus new rail textures and improved particle hit effects.

A New, Free Song for the Synthwave Essentials Pack - “Star Fighter” by Wice
Many of you have been asking for more Synthwave music, so we’re excited to bring you a track from the fantastic Danish synthwave and retro-electro artist, Wice.  With a punchy bassline and soaring synth leads, take this 2017 classic for a spin!

Play Profiles, Easy Way to Play Your Own Style
Select a combination of modifiers, hit the save icon up the top and create a new Play Profile.  Give it a name, a cover, and an icon.  Quickly access your favorite combinations of modifiers to match the type of play experience you want to have today.  Fitness, dance, or challenging - it’s up to you!

New Modifier Makes Notes Vanish Right Before Your Eyes
The Vanish Notes modifier is similar to the Prismatic Notes modifier, however, with this modifier active, notes will actually disappear and rails will be reduced to their nodes.  You’ll need to remember both the position and colour of the notes as you play.  Stack this with Prismatic Notes and you’ll get a randomising effect!

Unified, Filterable Leaderboards
We’ve made the switch to a single, central leaderboard for each song’s difficulty that will allow each player to set multiple scores based on the modifiers they have selected at the time!  Only want to see scores for your favorite combination of modifiers?  Select your 3x note jump speed, prismatic, small notes modifiers and the leaderboard will show only those scores on the right.  Use a Play Profile for that combination to make it easy to see who’s playing with your favorite modifiers.

Tightened Hit Accuracy
The Hit Accuracy modifier has been retired, instead, we have tightened up hit detection for everyone in Hard, Expert, and Master levels.  While this does not impact the scoring zones, it will make it more difficult to pass maps without moving or putting in the effort to complete rails and get to notes in time!

Plus... The Room Is Back!
Many of you watched our anniversary video and asked about the old apartment ready room, and we couldn’t answer.. because we’d already brought back all the old ready rooms ready for you to use!  You can select your favorite from the retro apartment (The Room), what happens when your apartment falls through a wormhole (The Void), giant stone structures, and futuristic heads (The Pit) and the rooftop overlooking Spin City (The Roof).


CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS

 We have reversed the crouch wall changes introduced in the “Fitness” update in the interests of accessibility.
 Onboarding for new players has improved, prompting colour selection, scaled play area suggestions for taller players and other important settings to give the player a better first experience in Synth Riders.
 Scale Up Play Area has now moved into Settings > Calibration, which means you can now also take your preferred values with you into Multiplayer.
 More refurbished and retimed maps for existing songs in the OST.
 Improvements to security around leaderboards, with scores now tied to your individual player ID.
 Subtle graphical improvements in all the stages.



BUG FIXES

 Fixed the selection and behavior of larger numbers of playlists (thanks Moinn)
 Fixed display of playlist information after accessing player settings (thanks Wirrel)


THANK YOU
A huge thank you to our beta testers: Dubu, Fasty, Hawkwolf, HeyFalcon, Ichderhorst, Jade, Kuritsa, Moinn, Njna, NotKouto, PG, R2, StarSage, Teebo, TougeVR, Von Arlin, Whattheshark, WinterZ, Xypher & Zekses. You have been fantastic in helping us test what has been such a lot of complex changes, so generous with your time and feedback which we will continue to work on in the updates to come!  Thank you so much for being a part of this process with us!

notes.title: HUGE Update - Multiplayer & Brand New UX Overhaul!
notes.content:
Today we are VERY excited to announce our largest single update yet! 
 
Players can now meet and play together in the brand new Multiplayer Mode and enjoy a completely redesigned, streamlined user interface. Additional updates include a brand new song, a new stage, new avatars, and new sound effects. Our map editor has also received some updates. Let’s break this down!
 
The first new feature is the cross-platform Multiplayer Mode. Get ready to challenge your friends and make new ones from around the world, all while playing your favorite OST and custom songs together! The multiplayer mode lets you join up to four other players at a time and race for the highest score. As you’re soaring through each song, you’ll be able to check the leaderboard in real-time to see how you are performing, (confirming that you are, crushing the competition and keeping that number one spot, right?). Multiplayer adds a whole new adrenaline rush to playing for our competitive players, and adds a fun, laidback way, to connect with fellow Synth Riders inside an amazing music environment.  We can’t wait to actually meet some of you and chat as we battle and connect together!
 
Before each multiplayer battle, players can further spice up the competition by choosing from a collection of modifiers such as “Prismatic Notes,”“Sudden Death,” etc. The new mode also supports voice chat in the game and in lobbies so you can trash talk —err, I mean, encourage— your opponent, decide what song you want to play next, etc.
 
The second major update you’ll notice in this release is the brand new UX and visual updates to parts of the game. You’ll notice the new menus are smoother, quicker and more intuitive when picking modes, songs, browsing music packs or just moving around the menu. We spent a lot of time listening to feedback for this and we’re excited to see what you think of the new changes!
 
and… that’s not all
 
To celebrate the multiplayer release, we have also added a bonus free song called “Code War” by Nutronic that’s a blast to play, and a new stage called “Abstract.” Lastly, we’ve created brand new, custom-designed avatars and sound effects for the game.
 
Let us know what you think of the update. As always, this would not be possible without our community, and we cannot wait to speak with you guys in our Synth Riders rooms. This game would not be what it is without you!
 
Game Change Log:

 Performance improvements throughout the game (starting the game is now a lot faster)
 Frame rate improvement in the gameplay
 27 songs from the OST have been remapped to improve audio sync issues and improve overall playability
 Cross-platform Multiplayer Mode for up to 5 players

 Restructured and simplified UX

  Draft mode

notes.title: Synth Riders 2019 Rewind
notes.content:
Happy New Year! 
As we enter into 2020 with a whole new set of exciting Synth Riders features, and with so many huge things planned, we thought it would be fun to look back at the past year’s accomplishments and get a little nostalgic.

You guys have been the most amazing community we could ever ask for and we couldn’t have gotten here without you! Let’s start this 2019 rewind by looking at some of the top Synth Riders songs that you most enjoyed playing this past year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33094909/2cc7f14783faa9777e98602fc9edc02a41236f5a.png

The most played song was "Lazer Pink" by Sunset Neon. This is a great EDM song with “synthwave” influences that also broke the mold beyond this very genre. We want to give a huge shout out to Omotea for their fantastic video featuring this Sunset Neon classic, and getting a quarter of a million views while at it!


https://youtu.be/rrUQHC-8D6Y


Your second favorite map this year was another Sunset Neon classic, “Tonight” which has become Synth Riders’ very own 80’s rock n’ roll anthem. ). Nobody captures the essence of this song on the game better than Touge, who nails the appropriate costume for this song on his underrated video masterpiece. 


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wQsR9kFC09g

Your third favorite song was "Enemy" by Blue Stahli, one of the harder electro-rock songs in the original Synthwave essentials pack. Xoxobluff really shows off getting her leg and core workout for the day playing below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bl-IQnL2Rhg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33094909/362c212789d25c8ebded08789feb37e8734768f3.png

As far as difficulties in the game, “Expert” was the most commonly played difficulty in 2019, followed closely by “Hard,” which we feel is just about when the game starts to get interesting.

It’s really important to us that Synth Riders is fun for everyone, regardless of their skill level, but we know that it is in the higher level of difficulty, such as Expert or Master, 
 that really cause you to move your body, experience some of the finer game mechanics and truly feel the music when you play. We’re glad so many people have been experiencing it at these levels

If you’re not there yet, make a resolution that 2020 is the year that you get there! You got this, we’re all behind you! (join one of the Synth Riders Discord groups to meet players, get support and tips)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33094909/3d6f27bb5e84b6aa534aecf681bb566a7aa701cd.png

Lastly, we just wanted to highlight a few of the major features we added in 2019. We’ve been working around the clock to make Synth Riders the best game possible and we think you’ll be very impressed with our 2020 roadmap. Coming up in the pipeline are new song packs, a complete overhaul to the UI, a more robust music discovery system, new features, game modes, and our much awaited multiplayer version, which is already being tested Get ready because in 2020, Synth Riders is about to become a whole new game!

Thanks again for making this year so special for us! We can’t wait for 2020, where we’ll actually get to meet some of you in the new multiplayer mode when that releases very soon!


Here’s to 2020 and another amazing year with you guys!!

notes.title: The version 2.0.4 is live!
notes.content:
We have a major update for everyone! We’ve been listening to all your feedback as we try to make this the ultimate VR synthwave experience.

A major request was simply that the game was too short! So we added Easy, Normal, Hard, and Expert levels to all the songs to create a game that was easy to learn but hard to master. We also added 5 new songs from top Synthwave artists:


 Scandroid - Neo-Tokyo (Dance With The Dead Remix)
 Sunset Neon - Tonight
 Powercyan - Space Rock (PYLOT remix)
 Robert Parker - End Of The Night (Feat. Doubleboy)
 Dance the Dead - From Hell



We heard that we needed to refine our game mechanics to add new challenges and improve playability. We’re releasing:


 Different colors for Right and Left handed notes
 An Energy Level system allowing a user to fail a level after missing too many notes
 A new scoring system based on Speed and Precision
 A new settings panel with audio, graphics, calibration and gameplay options


And we know that people loved the visuals and the ambience so we decided to double down. We implemented:


 New environmental music for loading and menus
 Two brand new Cyberpunk stages
 Stunning new visuals across the whole game
 Performance improvements so the great visuals can be seen on most machines


Finally, we’re excited to announce a Beatmap Editor! This will allow players to map notes to their own songs and play. While we’re not releasing it as part of this update, you can check out a first look in the video section.
Link: https://youtu.be/UnNTjGVc6KQ

Let us know your thoughts in the comments and most importantly Ride the Synth!
